title: Find the critical path of the Wi-Fi rollout
instructions:
## Which activities cannot slip?

The campus Wi-Fi rollout has these activities (durations in days):

| Id | Activity | Days | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Survey buildings | 4 | – |
| B | Order access points | 15 | A |
| C | Run cabling | 10 | A |
| D | Install switches | 5 | C |
| E | Mount access points | 6 | B, D |
| F | Configure controller | 3 | B |
| G | Test and hand over | 4 | E, F |

## Do this

1. Enter the network in the notation (`B "Order access points" 15 after A`). The studio computes early and late starts, slack and the critical path.
2. Work it out by hand first, then compare. Answer the questions on the right.
3. Now suppose ordering the access points took 11 days instead of 15. Which path is critical then, and what is the new duration? Try it in the studio, then put the original value back.
hints: Each activity: Id "Label" duration after predecessors, e.g. E "Mount access points" 6 after B, D
Forward pass gives early starts; the longest path to the end is the project duration.
Slack = late start − early start. Activities with zero slack form the critical path.
